The other fifteen wait as filed. WP06 is closed (f0d8bc79).
    (3) K0120 GREEN at 8a776229 on kovacs (kovacs-sysadm's END, 18:44:18Z): k0120.rc 0, 2966 ok, 0 not ok, 75 skipped, its seal empty, the clone clean. The one new skip is WP06's macOS cache arm, which runs on macOS only. Its slot 01M6C3JYKM1NVYCNZQ73X1VPAA is released as relayed. The cut's kovacs leg environment was probed after the clock read 18:45Z, the login announced to kovacs-sysadm: rustup's cargo first on PATH, bash 5.3.9, bats 1.12.0, shellcheck 0.11.0, intent 3.2.8, nproc 2, no shfmt (its arms skip there, as in K0120, and check all needs none), and ~/work/devbin-leg.git standing from WP05. kovacs-sysadm keeps kovacs free until vc announces the cut's start.

Before handing hv the cut, vc runs its dry run at the landed head, which also reads the draft's NOT REACHED check.

Then the sweep per sweep-plan.md, then WP10 to WP14, which give the artefact cache its first callers by wiring each estate's build handler to cache get and put where it declares a build: block (vc's ruling under decision 102, put to hv in vc's report).
